clauses.plain_language_summary: Allows one party to terminate or seize funds without adequate advance notice or cure opportunity.
clauses.practical_concern: Tenant/Obligor risks immediate loss of rights or security deposit without recourse.

clauses.plain_language_summary: Grants one party exclusive decision-making authority without objective standards.
clauses.explicit_statement: 2 If the Lessee defaults on rent payment by more than 3 days, or breaches any house rule, the entire security deposit shall be forfeited immediately to the Lessor at the Lessor's sole and absolute discretion without prior notice
clauses.practical_concern: Counterparty may impose unexpected fees, rules, or deductions arbitrarily.

citation.verbatim_quote: 2 If the Lessee defaults on rent payment by more than 3 days, or breaches any house rule, the entire security deposit shall be forfeited immediately to the Lessor at the Lessor's sole and absolute discretion without prior notice

clauses.plain_language_summary: Specifies the legal court or arbitration venue for dispute resolution.
clauses.practical_concern: Ensure the venue is accessible and not located in a distant jurisdiction.

silent_clauses.risk_implication: Document must specify the exact number of days (e.g. 15-30 days) to return the deposit and require itemized written receipts for any deductions.
silent_clauses.suggested_inquiry: Clarify in writing whether the agreement includes provisions for security deposit refund timeline & deductions.

silent_clauses.risk_implication: Clear definition of structural/major repairs borne by landlord versus minor tenant repairs.
silent_clauses.suggested_inquiry: Clarify in writing whether the agreement includes provisions for maintenance & habitability obligations.

silent_clauses.risk_implication: Explicit terms regarding renewal notice timelines and limits on arbitrary rent increases.
silent_clauses.suggested_inquiry: Clarify in writing whether the agreement includes provisions for automatic renewal & rent escalation caps.

escalations.risk_description: Unilateral or severe terms identified in: 'Allows one party to terminate or seize funds without adequate advance notice or cure opportunity.'
